pipeline.cpu_timing_scope: cpu_seconds fields use CLOCK_THREAD_CPUTIME_ID per worker; parser_cpu_seconds and decoder_cpu_seconds sum those worker CPU times
pipeline.jobs_completed_scope: jobs fully parsed and queued; only a successful scan proves complete decoding
pipeline.queue_depth_observation: maximum observed immediately after enqueue, not a continuous peak
pipeline.timing_scope: work, wait and input durations sum worker wall times; parser work includes input reads, decoder work includes optional export; these wall durations overlap

resident_input.scope: Full readonly source mapping locked with mlock; no HTTP. Existing range-buffer copies and CAR parser remain timed.

source.read_method: memory copy from mlocked readonly mapping

receipt.resident_timing_scope: scan_seconds includes memory range copies, CAR parsing, full transaction/metadata/rewards decode, hashes and worker startup/join; excludes mlock/preload, residency walks and profiler handshake

scan_resources.scope: RUSAGE_SELF delta around scan only; includes all reader threads; excludes preload, profiler handshake and final export

status.measurement_scope: scan timer excludes preload/mlock and control gates; includes memory copies, CAR parsing, full decode, hashes and worker startup/join
status.profiling_limit: perf and stage instrumentation change the workload cost; do not rank profiled samples against baseline timings
status.verification_limit: No export, output SHA, full output verifier or byte comparison; exact plan/count/source and residency checks remain mandatory
